gloss: familiarity with an area, local knowledge

definitions.gloss: familiarity with an area, sense of local geography
definitions.explanation: Knowledge of the layout, streets, and landmarks of a particular area, typically gained through experience of living in or frequently visiting that area.

examples.japanese: {土地勘|とちかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で⟦{迷|まよ}った→迷う：02426_mayou⟧。
examples.english: I got lost because I'm unfamiliar with the area.

examples.japanese: {土地勘|とちかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{案内|あんない}して→案内する：20203_annaisuru⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I had someone who knows the area guide me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{引|ひ}っ{越|こ}して→引っ越す：01171_hikkosu⟧きた⟦ばかり→〜ばかり：02006_bakari⟧で、⟦まだ→まだ：00603_mada⟧{土地勘|とちかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。

notes:
{土地勘|とちかん} refers to an intuitive sense of local geography — knowing the streets, landmarks, shortcuts, and general layout of an area, typically gained through living there or visiting frequently.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {土地勘|とちかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to know an area well)
- {土地勘|とちかん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ (to be unfamiliar with an area)
- {土地勘|とちかん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧ (someone who knows the area)
- {土地勘|とちかん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{活|い}かす→活かす：10422_ikasu⟧ (to put local knowledge to use)

USAGE:
Often comes up when discussing travel, moving to a new area, or asking for directions. Frequently used with ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧/⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧ to describe whether someone knows their way around.

WRITING:
Sometimes written as {土地鑑|とちかん} with {鑑|かん} (discernment), but {土地勘|とちかん} with ⟦{勘|かん}→勘：02149_kan⟧ (intuition) is the more common spelling today.
